context.capturedDuring: defining slices for simplify-data-model epic — agent followed skill instructions to write directly, breaking HMAC

description: Several skills contain instructions to mkdir -p and Write tool files directly into .goodplan/ (e.g., start-epic writes approved.md, create-slices writes sequencing.md and goal.md via mkdir + Write). These predate the HMAC enforcement and conflict with the state integrity system. Audit all skills for direct .goodplan/ write instructions and replace them with the corresponding CLI commands (gp slice:create, gp epic:activate, gp submit-slices, etc.). Known affected skills: start-epic (approved.md), create-slices (sequencing.md, goal.md, mkdir -p). May affect others — full audit needed.
name: update-skills-use-cli-not-direct-writes
title: Update skills that instruct agents to write directly into .goodplan/ to use CLI commands instead
